e.title: Driver Behavior Telematics
e.summary: 车联网驾驶行为分析：加速/刹车/转向特征提取 → 激进/正常/鲁莽分类 + 风险评分
e.body: Driver Behavior Analysis with Telematics（odul-okunakol）是完整的车联网驾驶行为分析项目：从速度/加速度/刹车强度/转向模式提取特征，用机器学习把驾驶员分为激进/正常/鲁莽三类，并输出可用于保单定价的风险评分。对 RIAA：UBI 定价的教学级完整流水线——特征工程 → 分类 → 风险评分 → 定价建议（同 [[grab-aiforsea-safety]] 的竞赛实现互补，偏教学完整性）；与 [[insurancerating]]（定价方法）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 衔接；保险公司客户细分/风险策略的直接参考。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：README 确认（特征提取→分类→风险评分完整流程），未实测
e.summary_en: Telematics driver-behaviour analysis: acceleration/braking/turning feature extraction → aggressive/normal/reckless classification + risk score
e.summary_hk: 車聯網駕駛行為分析：加速/剎車/轉向特徵提取 → 激進/正常/魯莽分類 + 風險評分
e.body_en: Driver Behavior Analysis with Telematics (odul-okunakol) is a complete telematics driver-behaviour project: extracting features from speed/acceleration/braking intensity/turning patterns, classifying drivers into aggressive/normal/reckless with machine learning, and outputting a risk score usable for policy pricing. For RIAA: a teaching-grade end-to-end pipeline for UBI pricing — feature engineering → classification → risk score → pricing recommendations (complementing [[grab-aiforsea-safety]]'s competition implementation with pedagogical completeness); links to [[insurancerating]] (pricing methods) and [[machine-learning-pricing]]; a direct reference for insurer customer segmentation and risk strategy.
e.body_hk: Driver Behavior Analysis with Telematics（odul-okunakol）是完整的車聯網駕駛行為分析項目：從速度/加速度/剎車強度/轉向模式提取特徵，用機器學習把駕駛員分為激進/正常/魯莽三類，並輸出可用於保單定價的風險評分。對 RIAA：UBI 定價的教學級完整流水線——特徵工程 → 分類 → 風險評分 → 定價建議（同 [[grab-aiforsea-safety]] 的競賽實現互補，偏教學完整性）；與 [[insurancerating]]（定價方法）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 銜接；保險公司客户細分/風險策略的直接參考。
